tiersDoc: Hardware sizing only: how much model this machine can hold. Selected first-match by ascending memoryGiBMax, so the open-ended tier stays last. Task difficulty lives in taskTiers; mixing the two makes an unconditional null match shadow every size.
taskTiersDoc: Task difficulty only: how much brain a request deserves. Never keyed by memory. Interactive HII uses local tier 2 for explicit deep work or a failed action when its model is installed; it prefers the already loaded local model otherwise. Tier 3 stays an explicit operator act.

taskTiers.name: tier-0-no-llm
taskTiers.description: Tool routing: grep, search, filesystem metadata, git status, calculations. Never sends a prompt payload to any model.

taskTiers.name: fast-4b-local
taskTiers.description: The default HII MLX worker for low-latency interaction and tool routing.

taskTiers.name: deliberate-35b-a3b
taskTiers.description: Difficult reasoning and long-context work with measured interactive throughput on this Mac. Explicitly selectable through the HII MLX engine.

taskTiers.name: hosted
taskTiers.description: Operator-invoked only, through /codex or /claude. Never entered automatically.

selectionCatalogDoc: Curated HII choices for explicit operator selection. This catalog recommends but never downloads, starts, switches, or routes a model by itself.

selectionCatalog.bestFor: Simple requests, tool routing, and minimum memory use
Stronger everyday reasoning and vision without 27B latency
Everyday assistance, tool use, hard reasoning, and long-context work

hostedCatalogDoc: Explicit hosted/browser-backed models. Selecting one records an external-transmission provider preference; HII never routes here automatically.

hostedCatalog.bestFor: Fast hosted reasoning through direct DOM control of the public Ox Alpha chat while HII retains tool authority

tiers.0: Deterministic — no LLM, tool routing only
tiers.3: cloud only — when local models fail, task is extremely consequential, or explicitly requested

metadata.reason: Keep HII as the automatic local default and add Ox Alpha website access as an explicit external model choice that uses HII's bounded tool protocol.
